# Get Forecast

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves the forecast in your local area.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getForecast(type: <#Enumeration (WFWeatherForecastType) (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getForecast(type: Hourly)
~~~~
